svg.title: Skills as a layer stack
svg.desc: L1 AI / ML: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, NLP, LLMs, RAG. L2 GenAI & Agentic: Multi-Agent Systems, AI Agents, CrewAI, LangGraph, Gemini, Llama 3, AWS Bedrock, OpenRouter. L3 AI Engineering: Prompt Engineering, Pydantic, FastAPI, Vector DBs (Qdrant), REST, WebSockets. L4 Data & Distributed: Kafka, Spark, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL. L5 Programming & Tools: Python, SQL, Docker, Git/GitHub. L6 Core CS: DSA, Problem solving
